subject: Re: VPC inference walkthrough — scheduling & coverage
messages:
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sarah.Wu@nebula.tech
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo: VPC inference walkthrough — Wed 6/16 10:00am PT

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the discovery call earlier. Per our conversation I'd like to schedule a focused VPC inference walkthrough for your infra + security teams next week. Proposed slot: Wednesday 6/16, 10:00–11:00am PT. Diego (SE) will cover network setup and the private deployment path; Aditya (AE) will cover procurement and integration checkpoints.

Agenda (30–40m demo + 20m Q&A):
- Architecture overview (Redwood Private VPC)
- Walkthrough: peering, routing, KMS integration
- Performance expectations and Dedicated capacity options
- Security/compliance & evidence collection steps

Action items before the demo: please share any staging VPC CIDRs we should use and the admin contact. Procurement mentioned an evidence checklist — if you can confirm must-haves we'll attach the SOC2 summary + data-retention policy ahead of time.

Attachment: [SOC2_Summary.pdf]

If 6/16 10am doesn't work, propose two alternate windows and we'll re-run coordination.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: monica_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: VPC inference walkthrough — Wed 6/16 10:00am PT

Soojin / Aditya —

Quick heads up: I have the oncall rotation handover scheduled the evening of 6/15. Historically those handovers can run into the morning if there are tail incidents. I can run the 6/16 slot if needed, but I expect the risk of context switching. Options I recommend:

1) Keep 6/16 and have Monica act as SE lead for the live walkthrough; I'll prep a detailed runbook and join if the oncall is stable.
2) Move the walkthrough to Thu 6/17 same time so I can be fully present.
3) Do a split session: I pre-record the network walkthrough and Monica handles live Q&A.

I'll attach a short oncall coverage runbook that details handover commands and how to escalate to Ops. If we ask the customer for a hard hold and explain the risk, that usually works.

Attachment: [runbook-oncall-coverage.md]

—Diego
Diego Fernández
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Sarah.Wu@nebula.tech
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-11T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: VPC inference walkthrough — scheduling and coverage

Hi Soojin / Diego / Aditya —

Thanks for the details. A few blockers on our side that force us to pause planning for the 6/16 slot:

- We have a planned network fabric upgrade in our primary DC on 6/15–6/16 which will restrict access to a number of test VPCs. That makes a live VPC walkthrough ineffective.
- Procurement is asking for a formal evidence list before Legal will sign the SOW; they specifically want SOC2 artifacts and a documented data-retention position.
- Security wants a brief technical Q&A and would like to know when a pen-test summary / timeline can be provided.

Given the maintenance window, we cannot run a meaningful VPC walkthrough on 6/16. Can we aim to reschedule for the week of 6/21? In the meantime, can you share the SOC2 summary and the data-retention policy, plus a short evidence checklist that Procurement can review? Also please provide an estimated date for pen-test artefacts so Security can triage.

Thanks,
Sarah Wu
Infra Lead, Nebula Systems
From: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
To: Sarah.Wu@nebula.tech
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-12T15:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo: VPC inference walkthrough — scheduling & coverage

Hi Sarah —

Appreciate the heads-up and the specifics. Totally makes sense to avoid the maintenance window. Two practical paths so we can keep momentum:

Option A — Reschedule live walkthrough to week of 6/21. Proposed: Tue 6/22, 11:00am PT (Aditya + Diego + Monica attend). Monica can be primary SE for the demo in case Diego's oncall still overlaps.

Option B — If you need something sooner, we can run a lightweight session on 6/17 that focuses on integration patterns (no live peering): Diego will provide a pre-recorded network walkthrough and Monica will handle live Q&A.

Immediate deliverables we will send today (per Procurement/Security ask):
- SOC2_Summary.pdf (attached)
- Data-retention-policy.pdf (attached)
- Evidence checklist (short doc) and a proposed timeline for pen-test summary (we estimate 4–6 weeks for an external pen test; we can share interim scan reports earlier).

If you confirm Option A or B Ill lock the slot and update HubSpot. We can also share the evidence tracker link for Procurement to comment.

Thanks again — apologies for the churn.
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Attachment: [SOC2_Summary.pdf, data-retention-policy.pdf]
